results.name: 1a. walked with the joystick from the entrée through the salon to the pool deck and round to the steps' head
1b. pushing toward the water at the steps' head walks the player down the steps into the water, treading
2a. swims with the joystick to each of the four corners of the water (in it all the while)
2b. at a swimming pace (about 1 m/s, a little more pushed to the rim), the stroke faster when faster
3. the stick at rest: drifts to a stop and treads water, upright (the Tread clip)
4. « Sortir de l'eau » by the south wall: out over it (hands on the coping), standing on the deck; hygiene and moral up
5. « Se baigner » at the edge: a slip into the water in well under a second, a splash, no jump
6. swimming into the steps walks the swimmer up them, out on the deck at the west end
7. the acceptance's pool step in real time: « Se baigner » at its edge, in the water, « Sortir de l'eau », cleaner
8a. the swimmer's footprint never left the water's rectangle (every frame in the water)
8b. the camera followed above the deck, never in the basin
8c. swim and tread both played, no jump of the body in or out of the water
